title.narrative: Mozambique - Improving inclusive and sustainable agro value chains development, including the Ibo specialty coffee one, of Cabo Delgado Province through Public Private Partnership approach

description.narrative: Following the official request received from the Provincial Directorate of Science and Technology, Higher and Technical Professional Education of Cabo Delgado Province and the assessment conducted, the present project has been developed with the aim of increasing the smallholders livelihood and income generation opportunities in Cabo Delgado Province (general objective). The specific objective is to improve targeted agro-value chains (from sustainable production, processing and marketing) including the Mozambican specialty coffee one (e.g. Coffee Racemosa Loureiro) through: a) establishment of an inclusive and sustainable development of the racemosa coffee value chain (especially in Ibo); b) improvement of IABil (Agrarian Institute of Bilibiza) capacities to provide extension services to the smallholder farmers such as add value to local crops, establish market linkages, distribution of racemosa coffee plants (product diversification and reforestation), laboratory services, etc. c) promotion of the Mozambican specialty coffee within the Country and abroad, for building the basis for the recognition in international markets of the quality of the Mozambican Racemosa coffee. The main outputs of the Project will be achieved through a value chain approach that will implement project activities for a period of three
